review_scope: Verified source coverage and reviewed FAQ, editorial headings, shipping estimates and garment size examples, all automated findings, and domain-specific parcel and price terminology.

corrections.source: Combining the two parcels creates a third scenario. Adding scale weights gives a rough goods total, but the combined outer dimensions must be measured or estimated separately. The dense books could fit beside the jacket, or they could require a different carton and additional protection to avoid crushing the gift box. The combined volume does not simply equal one old carton plus another. Calculate against the proposed outer package that will actually enter the carrier network.
corrections.translation: 把两件包裹合箱是第三种方案。相加秤上的读数可以粗估货物总重，但合箱后的外部尺寸还得单独测量或估算。书可能放得进夹克旁边，也可能需要换箱并增加防护，以免压坏礼盒。新包裹的体积不能直接用旧纸箱的体积相加。请按实际交给承运商的外包装计算。

corrections.source: For a short delivery, describe expected and observed counts in the same units. One missing pack of three pairs differs from one pair missing inside a pack. Name the exact item, order reference and supporting photograph when asking for assistance.
corrections.translation: 如果到货数量不足，请用同一种单位写明应到和实到数量。少了整包三双和一包里面少了一双是两种情况。联系客服时，列出具体商品、订单编号，并附上能说明差异的照片。

corrections.source: A public lookup can show earlier warehouse observations associated with a seller listing. Compare the selected option and date. Use photographs attached to your current order to decide whether your own delivery contains the right unit.
corrections.translation: 公开查询可能找到同一卖家链接下以前入库商品的照片。先核对拍摄日期和选定款式。判断你这次收到的是否为正确商品，应看绑定本次订单的实物照片。

corrections.source: The search did not return a reference for that input. Retest with the original marketplace listing and confirm the item identifier. A missing public photograph gives no measurement or quality information about the item.
corrections.translation: 这只说明当前输入没有返回可供参考的照片。用卖家的原始商品链接重试，并检查商品编号。没有公开照片，无法据此判断尺寸或质量。

corrections.source: Crop to one clearly visible item and use the image search. Treat its results as candidates. Compare the seller, original listing and option as well as physical details before attaching a reference to your order.
corrections.translation: 将截图裁到只留下一个清晰的商品，再用图片搜索。把结果当候选，除了对照外观，还要核对卖家、原始链接和所选款式，确认后再作为订单参考。

corrections.source: Look for a feature that would distinguish the versions, such as pocket opening, cuff shape or handle attachment. Even an exact match in a studio picture leaves the supplier and selected option unconfirmed.
corrections.translation: 找出能区分两个版本的细节，例如袋口、袖口形状或提手连接处。即使棚拍图完全相同，也不能据此确认供货方与商品选项相同。

corrections.source: Record the seller's original option text, colour swatch and any model suffix. Compare those details with the actual order confirmation. A general colour such as blue may cover several distinct options.
corrections.translation: 记下卖家的原文选项、色块和型号后缀，再与实际订单确认页逐项对照。“蓝色”这样的统称可能涵盖多个不同选项。

corrections.source: Start with a jacket that fits. Choose the dimension most likely to affect your decision, such as underarm width or back length. Name the endpoints and ask for the whole tape reading on the garment laid flat.
corrections.translation: 先量一件合身的夹克，确定最影响决定的是两腋间的身宽、后衣长还是其他尺寸。明确量尺起止点，请仓库把衣服放平，并拍到完整的量尺路径和读数。

corrections.source: Check the chart's definition first. A garment circumference can correspond approximately to twice its flat width; a recommended body chest range describes the wearer instead. Use a comparison garment measured the same way.
corrections.translation: 先看尺码表的定义。成衣胸围通常约为平铺胸宽的两倍，但推荐人体胸围描述的是穿衣者。用同样方法量一件自己的衣服再比较。

corrections.source: Compare photographs under more than one light and look for a neutral surface in the same frame. If the difference affects your decision, request a view with the option label and item together under neutral lighting.
corrections.translation: 比较不同光线下的几张照片，并在同一画面寻找中性色表面作参照。如果色差会影响是否保留，请仓库在中性光下将商品和选项标签拍在一起。

corrections.source: A crop might show the final number but hide the zero mark, measurement path or item identity. Request an overview showing the item reference and both endpoints, then use a close-up to read the scale.
corrections.translation: 局部特写可能只拍到终点读数，遮住零刻度、量尺路径或商品标识。先要一张能看见商品编号与测量两端的全景图，再用特写确认具体刻度。

corrections.source: Name the feature that matters, such as a rear pocket, strap attachment or laptop compartment. Ask for a view that can answer that question. Another front image is unlikely to resolve it.
corrections.translation: 明确你关心的是背面口袋、肩带固定处还是电脑隔层，请仓库拍能看清该处的角度。再拍一张正面照往往无助于解决这些问题。

corrections.source: Ask to see both internal size labels and compare their size system and model markings with the order. An overview establishes that two shoes are present but may not reveal a mismatched size.
corrections.translation: 请拍清左右两只鞋内侧的尺码标签，并把尺码体系和型号标记与订单核对。整双鞋的合照只能证明有两只鞋，不一定能发现左右尺码不同。

corrections.source: Match the selected seller option to the expected top and bottom. Ask for both pieces in one overview and check each size label if the sizes can be selected independently.
corrections.translation: 将卖家所选选项与预期的上衣、下装逐一对应。请拍一张两件放在一起的照片。如果上下装可分别选码，还要逐件检查尺码标签。

corrections.source: Record actual weight and outside packed dimensions for each scenario. Apply the current route's billing rules separately. A smaller scale reading does not guarantee a lower charge on a route that also considers volume.
corrections.translation: 分别记录两个方案的实重和打包后的外部尺寸，再按当前路线的计费规则计算。若路线也考虑体积，秤上更轻的包裹不一定更便宜。

corrections.source: Save the items included, packing choice, destination, route, quoted amount, currency and date. If you add an item or change the protection, obtain a revised quote against those new assumptions.
corrections.translation: 保存物品清单、包装方式、目的地、路线、报价金额、币种和日期。增加物品或更换防护包装后，应按变更后的条件重新报价。

corrections.source: First identify the tracking number and destination. Domestic delivery can mean an arrival at the agent warehouse. If the international number shows delivery, compare its destination and contact the relevant carrier or support channel.
corrections.translation: 先确认运单号码和目的地。境内段的“已送达”可能是到达代购仓库。如果国际运单显示已送达，核对目的地，并联系对应承运商或客服。

corrections.source: Provide the outbound parcel reference, tracking number, last dated event and destination country. Ask what the next expected handoff is. A screenshot without the reference is harder to associate with the right shipment.
corrections.translation: 提供出库包裹编号、运单号、最后一条有日期的记录和目的国家，询问接下来预计由谁接手。没有编号的截图很难对应到具体包裹。

corrections.source: Save the candidate seller's original listing URL and the exact option you are considering. Keep the image-search result separately so you can later distinguish how you found the item from where you intend to order it.
corrections.translation: 保存候选卖家的原始商品链接，并注明你考虑的具体选项。图片搜索结果另存，这样日后能分清你是怎样发现商品、又打算从哪里购买。

corrections.source: A still image can show a pull, teeth or an open zipper. If operation matters, ask whether the warehouse can perform the particular check. Avoid assuming movement from a static view.
corrections.translation: 静态照片能看到拉片、链齿或拉开的状态。若顺畅度很重要，请先问仓库能否做相应的操作检查。不能仅凭照片判断活动时的表现。

corrections.source: Measure your reference jacket from the same collar point to the cuff. A measurement taken from the shoulder seam describes a different span, especially on a raglan sleeve.
corrections.translation: 从自己夹克相同的领口位置一直量到袖口。以肩缝为起点测的是另一段长度，插肩袖尤其容易出现差别。

corrections.source: Read the selected option and the seller's description of included pieces. If the bag is essential, request confirmation before ordering and look for it separately in your warehouse photographs.
corrections.translation: 查看卖家对所选选项和随附物品的说明。如果防尘袋必不可少，先确认再下单，入库后还要在实物照片中单独核对。

corrections.source: Review the packed dimensions, weight, route and services in both calculations. Removing an item may change the box or eligible routes. Keep both estimates with their respective packing assumptions.
corrections.translation: 把两次计算中的成箱尺寸、重量、路线和服务逐项比较。拿走商品可能改变纸箱型号或可用路线。保留两份报价，并标明各自的包装条件。

corrections.source: Use the local delivery number if the shipment record supplies one, and include the original outbound number as a cross-reference. Confirm that the destination shown belongs to your parcel before relying on its delivery scan.
corrections.translation: 如果物流记录给出当地派送单号，优先提供该号码，同时附上原国际运单号供交叉查询。确认页面目的地确实属于你的包裹后，再采信其送达记录。

corrections.source: Imagine a friend sends you a screenshot of a brown backpack and an agent product link. You care about two things: whether a large tablet fits in the rear sleeve and whether the shoulder straps can be detached. The screenshot shows the exterior and the agent link still opens. A previous buyer's gallery would be interesting, but it will help only if you can tie the photographs to the same version of the backpack and to one of those two questions.
corrections.translation: 假设朋友发来一张棕色背包的截图和一个代购商品链接。你关心的是两件事：后侧夹层能否放下大号平板电脑，以及肩带能否拆下。截图只显示外观，代购链接仍然可以打开。其他买家的照片只有在能对应到同一款背包，而且能回答这两个问题中的至少一个时，才是有用的参考。

corrections.source: Submit the verified link to a reference lookup and inspect the results. Suppose the first sequence shows a backpack matching the front profile, followed by a close photograph of a metal buckle. The buckle view might support the possibility of a detachable strap, but it does not show the connection at both ends. Another sequence shows the inside of a blue bag with a narrow sleeve. If the seller offers both colours in the same size and model, the blue interior may be a useful lead. Without a way to identify its size, it cannot tell you whether your tablet fits.
corrections.translation: 用核实过的链接查询。假设第一组照片的背包外形吻合，还拍到一个金属扣，却没有拍全肩带两端，所以只能说明肩带可能可拆。另一组蓝色背包的内袋较窄。若两种颜色的款式和尺寸相同，这张内袋图可作线索；无法确认尺寸时，不能据此保证你的平板放得进去。

corrections.source: Record these as two different findings. One is about the type of hardware observed on a historical item. The other raises a question about sleeve width. Save the source and date beside each. Keeping such observations separately prevents a later note from gradually turning into a much stronger claim that all brown backpacks from the listing have detachable straps and a large rear compartment.
corrections.translation: 把两项发现分开记录：一项是历史实物照片中可见的扣件，另一项是仍待确认的夹层宽度。分别注明来源和日期。这样不会在转述时把有限的线索扩大成“该链接下所有棕色背包都配可拆肩带和宽大的后侧夹层”。

corrections.source: Return to the tablet example and measure the device with its normal case. The product page may describe a maximum screen size, which is a diagonal measurement and can conceal differences in width or thickness between devices. Identify the actual sleeve opening and usable depth you need. If you ask for one internal width measurement, specify where the tape should run and whether the opening narrows at the top. A ruler placed across the outside of the backpack would answer a different question.
corrections.translation: 先给平板装上平时使用的保护壳，再量长宽和厚度。商品页写的最大屏幕尺寸是对角线，并不反映机身的宽度或厚度。要查的是包内插袋的净开口和有效深度。请仓库量内宽时，指出卷尺的走向，并问袋口上方是否收窄；从背包外侧横放直尺，量到的是另一个尺寸。

corrections.source: A front view cannot establish whether a backpack has an internal sleeve. Ask for the main compartment open with the rear wall visible. An exterior detail shot cannot settle a question about a detachable lining; ask for its attachment point inside the garment.
corrections.translation: 只看正面无法判断背包是否有内夹层。请把主仓打开，拍到靠背一侧的内壁。相应地，衣服外侧的特写也不能确定内衬能否拆卸，应请对方拍衣服内部的连接处。

corrections.source: Phrase a measurement request to reduce ambiguity
corrections.translation: 写清尺寸测量要求，减少误解

corrections.source: Evaluate the returned view as evidence
corrections.translation: 判断拍回来的角度能证明什么

corrections.source: Build an expected contents list
corrections.translation: 列出应到的所有物品

corrections.source: Compare the item with what is visible
corrections.translation: 对照订单与照片中可见的物品

corrections.source: Separate boxes from purchase lines
corrections.translation: 把收到的箱数与采购行数分开看

corrections.source: Close or escalate each discrepancy
corrections.translation: 逐项解决差异或提交跟进

corrections.source: Reconcile three purchase lines with two warehouse entries
corrections.translation: 把三条采购明细与两条入库记录对上

corrections.source: Ask for confirmation without disturbing the wrong item
corrections.translation: 明确待查物品，避免动到别件

corrections.source: Reconcile the outbound packing plan
corrections.translation: 核对出库打包清单

corrections.source: Measure the same object at each stage
corrections.translation: 每个阶段都说明测量对象

corrections.source: Apply only the rule stated for the route
corrections.translation: 只采用当前路线明确列出的计费规则

corrections.source: Evaluate a packing change in context
corrections.translation: 结合整件包裹评估包装调整

corrections.source: Compare routes after establishing eligibility
corrections.translation: 先核实路线能否承运，再比较价格

corrections.source: Work through a packing decision with a real constraint
corrections.translation: 在明确限制下选择包装方案

corrections.source: Inspect the compact heavy parcel on its own terms
corrections.translation: 按实际条件单独评估紧凑而重的包裹

corrections.source: Identify which change could move the final quote
corrections.translation: 哪些变化会影响最终运费报价？

corrections.source: Start with a dated scenario
corrections.translation: 先记录估算日期与方案

corrections.source: Capture the route and included services
corrections.translation: 记录路线和报价包含的服务

corrections.source: Work through a changed estimate
corrections.translation: 核查一份发生变化的估价

corrections.source: Reconcile or ask for clarification
corrections.translation: 对上明细，仍有差额再问清楚

corrections.source: Reconstruct four versions of the same planned shipment
corrections.translation: 还原同一寄送计划的四个版本

corrections.source: Use a controlled comparison when only one thing interests you
corrections.translation: 只研究一个因素时，让其他条件保持一致

corrections.source: Handle missing records without inventing the old inputs
corrections.translation: 记录缺失时，避免猜填旧数据

corrections.source: Match the reference to its destination
corrections.translation: 把运单号与对应目的地对上

corrections.source: Read each event literally
corrections.translation: 按原文理解每条物流事件

corrections.source: Resolve common apparent contradictions
corrections.translation: 理清看似矛盾的几种物流状态

corrections.source: Open a focused enquiry
corrections.translation: 提出一个具体的物流查询

corrections.source: Read a tracking timeline as a sequence of evidence
corrections.translation: 按时间顺序梳理每条追踪证据

corrections.source: Investigate a delivered scan using the right identifiers
corrections.translation: 用正确的编号核查“已送达”记录

corrections.source: Write a support message that distinguishes delay from an exception
corrections.translation: 写清是进度延迟还是出现异常

corrections.source: A QC search has two stages. First identify the seller listing. Then decide which photographs of that listing actually help with the option you plan to buy. A successful lookup settles the first question only.
corrections.translation: 查验货参考图分两步。先找对卖家的商品页，再判断该页关联的哪些照片能回答你对于具体款式的问题。搜到相似外观只是第一步。

corrections.source: An independent VigorBuy QC finder describes accepting seller URLs and agent URLs for lookup. If an agent link opens an unrelated result, retry with the seller listing you have verified. If all you have is a picture, use visual search to identify candidates first. Treat every visual match as a lead until you have connected it to the right seller or product specification.
corrections.translation: 一个独立的 VigorBuy 验货图查询工具说明，它接受卖家链接和代购链接。如果代购链接跳到了无关结果，可以用已核实的卖家商品页重试。只有图片时，先用以图搜图筛选候选项。只有能与卖家身份或商品规格对应，才能将其作为进一步判断的依据。

corrections.source: Take a backpack listing with plain and printed colourways. A recent reference can clearly show the shape of the bag, but it may hide the inside of the printed version. State what the image supports. An exterior profile can help identify proportions; an open bag photograph is needed to inspect a divider. A screenshot that has been cropped to the front panel cannot settle both questions.
corrections.translation: 例如背包分为纯色和印花款。一组近期照片可能清楚拍出了包型，却没有展示印花款的内部。侧面外观可以判断大致比例；分隔层则要看打开背包后的照片。只留下正面剪裁图的截图无法同时回答这两个问题。

corrections.source: For each reference, save the seller URL, image source and one specific observation. For example, the zip extends beyond the side pocket, or the inner pocket is visible but its closure is hidden. Avoid impressions such as looks fine when the outstanding question concerns a detail.
corrections.translation: 每组参考图都应保存卖家网址、图片出处和一条可核实的观察。例如，拉链超过侧袋边缘，或能够看见内袋但袋口被挡住。问题涉及具体部件时，“看起来不错”不足以说明你确认了什么。

corrections.source: An empty public search is also a result you can interpret carefully. It means no relevant photographs appeared for the input you used. Verify the link, look at independent references if available and decide whether the missing evidence changes your purchase decision. Avoid converting an absence of public images into a claim about the seller's reliability.
corrections.translation: 公开搜索没有结果，只说明这次输入没有匹配到可用照片。核对链接，查看其他独立来源，并考虑这项缺失是否影响购买。不能据此判断卖家是否可靠。

corrections.source: When the correct link returns no photos, check the current seller images and written product specifications directly. Decide whether a current order inspection could resolve the outstanding question at a stage that still works for you. If a dimension is critical to the purchase itself, ask before ordering. A feature you cannot confirm until after intake may affect whether you are comfortable proceeding under the current seller terms.
corrections.translation: 用正确链接仍搜不到验货图时，直接查现行商品页的图片和文字规格。考虑入库后再查是否还来得及影响你的选择。如果某个尺寸决定买不买，应在下单前问清楚。只有入库后才能验证的特征，需要结合卖家条款决定是否值得承担不确定性。

corrections.source: A final check is whether somebody else can reproduce the lookup from your notes. Send yourself the plain listing URL without signing in, reopen it, and check whether it still names the seller and item you intended. Preserve the selected option separately if that choice disappears outside your session.
corrections.translation: 最后测试记录是否足以复现查询。把不含账户信息的原始商品网址发给自己，在未登录状态重新打开，核对是否仍显示预期卖家和商品。若退出会话后选中的版本消失，就把该选项另存。

corrections.source: VigorBuy buyer tutorial
corrections.translation: VigorBuy 买家操作指南

corrections.source: A photo search can recognize the broad shape of a jacket without distinguishing two sellers offering nearly identical versions. Use its results to uncover candidates, then test the details that could prove a candidate wrong.
corrections.translation: 以图搜图能识别夹克的大致轮廓，却不一定分得清两个卖家卖的相似版本。先找候选商品，再逐一检查哪些细节能排除不符的款式。

corrections.source: Try two different crops if the first result is unclear. Use the full garment for silhouette and a second crop that contains a distinctive construction feature. If both lead to the same candidate, open that listing. Agreement between two searches is a reason to inspect it, not proof of identity.
corrections.translation: 第一轮结果不清楚时，试两种裁图：整件衣服用来看轮廓，另截带有辨识度的结构细节。若两次都指向同款，打开商品页核实。重复搜到同一结果只值得进一步检查，还不能确认款式完全一致。

corrections.source: List the features visible in your original picture before you study the results closely. Count pockets, identify zip direction and compare where a panel meets the side seam. A different number of eyelets or an absent sleeve pocket can rule out a candidate even when its principal colours match.
corrections.translation: 仔细看搜索结果前，先列出原图能确定的特征：口袋数量、拉链方向、拼片与侧缝交接的位置。即便主色相同，金属孔数量不同或少了袖袋，都可以成为排除某个候选商品的依据。

corrections.source: Distinguish actual differences from changes in view. A pocket concealed by a model's arm is unobserved. A flat front photograph with a clear uninterrupted panel where the pocket should be is stronger evidence of a mismatch. Note which observation led you to discard the candidate so that a second listing using the same photograph does not restart your search.
corrections.translation: 先排除角度差异。如果口袋被模特手臂遮住，只能记为没看见。若平整的正面照片清楚显示应有口袋的位置是一整块无缝面料，这才更能说明不匹配。记下排除理由，避免另一条商品链接复用同图时重新走一遍。

corrections.source: Check marketplace, seller and item number after opening a candidate. If the original picture came from a known listing, compare the identifiers directly. The same promotional image can travel between sellers or be reused on multiple variants. A link that leads to a different seller calls for a fresh evaluation of the offer.
corrections.translation: 打开候选商品页后，核对平台、卖家和货号。如果原图来自已知商品页，直接比较两个标识。不同卖家和同一家店的多个款式都可能共用宣传图。遇到不同卖家，需要重新评估这家店实际出售的商品。

corrections.source: Suppose the first search returns three visually close jackets. Candidate A shares the blue colour and striped cuff but has two horizontal chest pockets clearly visible in its front photograph. Candidate B appears to have the correct pocket and cuff, yet its alternate view shows a snap fastening where the original visibly has a zip. Candidate C has the visible cuff, diagonal pocket and zip, but its seller page groups four jacket options together. The first two can be set aside for an identified reason. The third remains a candidate while you determine which option the picture represents.
corrections.translation: 假设三个候选款都很像。A 的蓝色和条纹袖口一致，但正面清楚拍到两个横向胸袋。B 的口袋和袖口相符，另一个角度却能看见它用按扣，而原图是拉链。C 的袖口、斜胸袋和拉链都一致，但卖家把四个款式放在同一商品页。可以有据地排除 A、B；C 仍要查图片具体对应哪一款。

corrections.source: A crop focused only on the cuff might return A again. That does not overturn the conflicting pocket evidence. The search has answered a narrower question about cuff similarity. Try a second crop including the pocket and zip together. If C appears again, inspect the seller page and option text. Do not rely on the order of the search results as a ranking of seller accuracy, product condition or available stock.
corrections.translation: 只裁袖口搜图，A 可能又出现在结果里。这只能说明两款袖口相似，不会推翻胸袋不一致的证据。再裁一张同时包含胸袋和拉链的图；若又找到 C，再看商品页和选项文字。搜图排名不能证明卖家信息准确、商品状态良好或目前有货。

corrections.source: Compare images at a similar angle. The edge of a pocket can disappear when a jacket is open, and a mirrored promotional image can reverse the side on which a logo appears. Look for text or another known orientation cue before treating left and right as decisive. A different count of visible fasteners on two fully opened cuffs is usually easier to interpret than the apparent width of a sleeve viewed from different angles.
corrections.translation: 尽量对比角度接近的照片。夹克敞开时，口袋边缘可能被盖住；镜像宣传图会让标志出现在相反一侧。先找可读文字等方向线索，再把左右作为判断依据。两个完全打开的袖口上扣具数量不同，比在不同角度下看起来袖管宽窄不同更容易判定。

corrections.source: Remember that close-ups change scale. A chest patch can fill the same area of the screen on a small bag and a large bag. Use its placement relative to seams, zip stops and corners rather than comparing pixel widths from different images. A neutral background can clarify silhouette, but it does not identify the seller or prove the item was photographed recently.
corrections.translation: 特写会改变画面比例。小包和大包的贴标都可能占据同样多的屏幕空间，不宜比较不同照片的像素宽度。应看贴标相对接缝、拉链止口和包角的位置。干净背景便于观察轮廓，但不能证明卖家是谁或照片拍摄于近期。

corrections.source: Avoid bringing conclusions from one candidate into the next. Keep a separate note for C's marketplace, seller, selected option and evidence. A label visible on A tells you nothing about C. Similarly, a measurement printed on a chart from B must not be reused to choose a size on C merely because all three jackets look similar. Each seller page has its own option definitions and order conditions.
corrections.translation: 候选商品之间不能借用证据。给 C 的平台、卖家、所选版本及图片单独建档。在 A 的标签上看到的信息不能说明 C；即使三个夹克外观再像，也不能拿 B 的尺码表为 C 选尺码。要以每个卖家自己定义的选项和订单条件为准。

corrections.source: Keep the source photograph and candidate record with any later order. When the warehouse photos arrive, compare the actual received item to the version you purchased, not to a different candidate discarded early in the search. That last switch in reference point is important: once you knowingly choose an alternative seller, your strongest order evidence is that seller's actual selected offer and confirmation.
corrections.translation: 把原图和候选商品资料留在后续订单旁。入库后，以实际买下的版本核对收到的货，不要拿早已排除的另一款来比较。如果主动换了卖家，最有力的订单依据便是新卖家所选的具体商品和付款确认。

corrections.source: One reasonable outcome of a search is an empty shortlist. Suppose three promising thumbnails all resolve to retailers using the same promotional image and none identifies the item underneath. Saving all three as corroboration would make your file look stronger than it is. Record the shared photograph once and write down the feature you still need to see. That gives the next search a purpose.
corrections.translation: 候选清单可以是空的。三张看似合适的缩略图若都来自复用同一宣传图的商家，又都没标清图上的商品，收藏三个链接也不能当作三份相互印证的证据。保留一次共用图片，再写下需要看到的特征，供下一次查询。

corrections.source: One seller listing can contain several products that look alike. A QC photograph associated with its item number may show any one of them. Work down from listing identity to the specific feature that distinguishes your selected model.
corrections.translation: 同一个卖家链接可以包含几款外形相近的商品。按货号查到的验货图可能拍的是其中任意一款。先确定商品页，再查能够区分你所选版本的那项具体特征。

corrections.source: Select each candidate and note changes to its swatch, image, price and option code. A price difference can signal different contents but cannot identify which feature caused it. Save the wording and the version shown in your checkout record. A link reopened later may start on the first option instead of the last one selected.
corrections.translation: 分别选中每个候选款式，记录色块、图片、价格和选项代码有没有变化。价格不同可以提醒你它们并非同一个选项，但具体差别仍要看卖家文字，而不是从价差猜测用料。

corrections.source: Write the outcome in three parts. Identify the paid option, the evidence on the current warehouse entry and the remaining uncertainty. For instance, the order calls for the lined medium; the warehouse label shows medium; the lining attachment remains hidden. This invites one directed photograph instead of a broad request to check everything again.
corrections.translation: 记录分三部分：已付款的选项、本次入库证据和仍未确认的地方。例如，订单选了有里布的 M 码，仓库标签显示 M，但里布的连接方式没拍到。这样只需请仓库补拍连接处，无须笼统要求重新检查所有内容。

corrections.source: Suppose a seller offers three black rain jackets under a single listing. The first is an unlined shell, the second has a fixed fabric lining and the third has a removable inner layer. The pictures at the top of the page show a model wearing a black jacket with the front closed. You need the removable layer for alternating temperatures. The seller item number and the word black identify three possible units, only one of which meets the main requirement.
corrections.translation: 例如一个链接同时卖三件黑色雨衣：无里布外壳、缝死布里、可拆内层。主图都是模特穿着未敞开的黑色夹克。若购买目的是随气温拆装内层，卖家货号和黑色这个选项只能缩小到三款，其中仅一款满足需求。

corrections.source: Make a small model key from the actual seller options. Copy the original wording for the shell, fixed lining and removable lining. Note any model letters, price differences and size ranges. If the translation calls both lined versions insulated, keep the original names as separate entries rather than merging them. Take a screenshot of the removable version selected in your intended size. The buyer can now describe the purchase without relying on a visually ambiguous front picture.
corrections.translation: 把实际可选款做一张对照表。逐字抄下无里布、固定里布和可拆里布的卖家原名，并记录款式字母、差价和尺码范围。机器翻译可能把后两种都叫“保暖款”，但不要合并。选中想买的尺码和可拆款后截图，之后便能准确描述所购版本。

corrections.source: Review an older public QC sequence. A clear view of a lining at the collar shows that a photographed jacket had an inner layer. It does not establish whether the layer is removable. A close-up of a zip in a different sequence might show the main front zip instead of the attachment. Look for a view establishing the position and purpose of the zip, such as the inner layer partly detached from the outer shell. The distinction follows the original decision, which was about removal rather than the mere presence of fabric.
corrections.translation: 一组旧验货图从领口拍到里布，只能说明当时被拍的夹克有内层，不能证明可拆。另一组拉链特写也可能拍的是前襟拉链。需要能确认拉链位置和用途的照片，例如内胆从外壳上部分拆开。买家关心的是能否拆卸，不是有没有一块布。

corrections.source: Two jacket lengths can differ by only a few centimetres. One image might show the short size medium while another shows the long version in small. A length difference could reflect both the size and the cut. Compare the seller size chart for the same marked size across the two versions, and check whether the chart specifies a different starting point. A measurement taken from the collar seam should not be compared directly with one taken from the highest shoulder point.
corrections.translation: 两款夹克的衣长可能只差几厘米。一张图可能是短款 M 码，另一张却是长款 S 码，差异同时受版型和尺码影响。请对照卖家尺码表里两款相同标称尺码的数据，确认衣长起点是否一致。从领缝量的长度不能直接与从肩部最高点量的长度比较。

corrections.source: With multiple units in one order, assign a separate record to each. Mark one as the medium removable-lining option and another as the large shell, for example. If the warehouse posts a series of pictures against a combined entry, identify which wide shot belongs to which close view. Request an overview showing each unit with its distinguishing feature when a cropped photograph cannot establish the assignment.
corrections.translation: 一个订单里有几件夹克，就为每一件单独建记录，例如可拆内胆 M 码、无里布 L 码。合并入库记录若配了一组照片，要分清哪张全景对应哪张特写。裁剪图无法对应时，请仓库将每件衣服连同区别款式的特征拍在同一张照片里。

corrections.source: If the seller confirms the layer is sewn in, compare that reply with the saved option. A mismatch between a documented removable version and a fixed lining is an issue to raise through the order before making further packing decisions. If the original wording never described a detachable layer, the question may instead concern your interpretation of the listing. Those situations require different conversations, and keeping the model key makes the difference visible.
corrections.translation: 卖家若确认内胆缝死，就对照已保存的购买选项。选项明确可拆而实物缝死，应在继续打包前通过订单提出差异。若原说明本来没承诺可拆，则应先澄清自己对商品页的理解。保存各版本对照表有助于区分这两种情况。

corrections.source: Sleeve length requires particular care. A jacket with a dropped shoulder can have a short seam-to-cuff measurement despite reaching the same place on your wrist. For a raglan sleeve, a neck-to-cuff measurement may be more useful. Photograph your measuring method so it can be repeated on the warehouse item.
corrections.translation: 袖长的起点尤其容易弄错。落肩款的肩缝本就靠下，从肩缝量到袖口可能较短，穿上后却仍到手腕同一位置。插肩袖可以改量领口到袖口。给自己的量法拍照，仓库才能对在库夹克重复同一操作。

corrections.source: Imagine a reference jacket is 55 centimetres across the chest when laid flat. A seller chart showing 110 centimetres might describe full garment circumference. It could also be a body-size recommendation. Read the chart's legend before dividing or doubling anything. Ask which measurement it represents when that is unclear.
corrections.translation: 假设把自己的夹克平铺，胸部横向量得 55 厘米。卖家尺码表上的 110 厘米可能是成衣胸围，也可能是建议穿着者的身体胸围。先读图例，弄清指的是哪一种，再决定能否乘二或除二；有疑问就向卖家确认。

corrections.source: For this example, imagine your reference jacket has enough chest room but the back hem rides slightly high. You want roughly the same chest width and a longer back, not a universally larger garment. Write down the desired changes separately. Choosing a larger labelled size simply to gain length could increase the body width beyond what you need while still leaving the sleeves or hem unsuitable.
corrections.translation: 假设自己的夹克胸部空间正好，但后摆偏短。真正的需求是保持近似胸宽、增加后长，而非整件衣服都大一码。把两个目标分开写。若只为衣长而选大码，衣身可能过宽，袖长或下摆仍未必合适。

corrections.source: Lay the reference flat with the normal fastening closed. Measure from one underarm seam to the other and note any padding or elastic that makes the seam hard to locate. Measure the centre-back length from the collar attachment to the hem. For reach, measure from the centre back of the neck across the shoulder and down the sleeve if that path matches the seller's chart. Take a simple picture of each tape position on your own garment. These pictures are useful instructions for a later warehouse request.
corrections.translation: 把自己的参考夹克按平时方式扣好、平铺。横量两侧腋下接缝之间的距离；若填充物或松紧带使接缝难找，要注明。后中长从后领与衣身连接处量至下摆。如卖家采用相同路径，袖长可从后领中点经肩沿袖量到袖口。逐一拍下卷尺位置，方便仓库按同一方法复测。

corrections.source: Suppose your readings are 56 centimetres flat chest, 66 centimetres centre-back length and 84 centimetres from centre neck to cuff. These are invented examples, not recommended sizes. A chart showing 56 centimetres chest width and 70 centimetres back length could be promising. Before using it, check whether it describes the exact model, whether the length is from the same starting point and whether the chest number refers to the garment rather than the person meant to wear it.
corrections.translation: 假设自己夹克的平铺胸宽为 56 厘米，后中长为 66 厘米，从后领中心到袖口为 84 厘米。这些数字只用于演示。卖家尺码表若标注胸宽 56 厘米、后长 70 厘米，可以进一步对照。先确认尺码表适用于所选款式，两件衣服的后长是否从同一点起量，以及胸部尺寸指成衣还是穿着者的身体。

corrections.source: Imagine one option lists a 55-centimetre flat chest and a 69-centimetre back. Another lists a 58-centimetre chest and a 71-centimetre back. The first is close to the chest you like, while the second adds more back length and room. The correct choice depends on how much change you want in each dimension. There is no useful average of chest and length that can establish fit because the two measurements address different needs.
corrections.translation: 假设第一个尺码的平铺胸宽为 55 厘米，后长 69 厘米；第二个胸宽 58 厘米，后长 71 厘米。第一个的胸宽接近你喜欢的穿着效果，第二个更宽松、后身也更长。选择取决于你希望各部位分别增加多少余量。胸宽和衣长解决的是不同问题，把两个数取平均值并不能判断是否合身。

corrections.source: When reviewing the picture, inspect whether the tape starts exactly at the seam, runs flat and follows the path requested. If the final reading lies between marks, note an approximate value instead of converting it into a spurious exact size. A small discrepancy can arise from a folded hem, compressed padding or different positioning. Ask for a repeat when that uncertainty could change the decision.
corrections.translation: 检查卷尺是否正从接缝起量、贴平面料，并沿约定路径摆放。读数落在两格之间时写约数。下摆折起、填充物受压或摆放不同，都可能造成小差异。只有这种不确定性会改变选择时，才需要请仓库复测。

corrections.source: If an image shows a stated 70 centimetres but the starting point is hidden behind the collar, ask specifically for the collar attachment and hem in the same frame. A tighter close-up on the number 70 will not solve the missing endpoint. If the full frame is clear but the markings are too small, request a second close view in addition to the overview. Together they establish what was measured and what the result was.
corrections.translation: 如果照片上能读到 70 厘米，但卷尺起点被衣领挡住，请仓库把领子与衣身连接处和下摆拍在同一张照片里。单独放大数字 70 仍看不到起点。反过来，如果全景清楚但刻度太小，可以保留全景，再补拍刻度近照，两张图合起来才能说明测了哪里、量得多少。

corrections.source: Keep one copy of the reference garment measurements even if you abandon the listing. Next time you compare a jacket, check whether its cut and intended layering resemble that reference before relying on the figures. A lightweight cardigan that fits under a coat may need less room than the insulated layer you actually intend to wear.
corrections.translation: 即使最终放弃这个商品页，也要保留参考夹克的实测记录。以后比较新夹克时，先看版型和穿搭层数是否接近。穿在大衣里的薄针织衫，与准备内搭的保暖衣物，所需松量可能完全不同。

corrections.source: Check a neutral surface within the same image. If white paper, a grey background and the garment all look unusually warm, lighting or white balance may explain part of the shift. Compare different pictures of the same unit before treating one warm-looking sleeve as a mismatch.
corrections.translation: 看看同一张照片里有无中性色参照物。如果白纸、灰背景和衣服一起显得发黄，灯光或白平衡可能造成了部分色偏。先比较同一件商品的其他照片，再判断某侧袖子是否真的颜色不对。

corrections.source: Shadow, fabric texture and angle matter. Velvet, satin and reflective fabric can change visibly as the surface turns. A close-up of a fold may look quite different from a broad, evenly lit front panel. Compare equivalent areas facing the light in a similar way.
corrections.translation: 阴影、面料表面和角度都会改变观感。天鹅绒、缎面和反光材料转动后，看起来可能明显不同。一道褶皱的特写不能直接对照均匀受光的整块前身；尽量找面料位置相似、朝向光线相近的区域比较。

corrections.source: A buyer coordinating pieces from separate sellers faces additional uncertainty even if both listings use the same colour name. Record that risk before relying on a historical QC image. When the colour match is essential, decide whether the available evidence is good enough while the item can still be inspected, and check the current order-specific options with support.
corrections.translation: 从不同卖家处搭配同色商品，即使两个链接采用相同色名，实物是否相配仍有额外不确定性。使用旧验货图前把这一点记下来。若颜色匹配是必要条件，应在还可检查商品时评估证据是否充分，并从订单客服确认本单有哪些处理选项。

corrections.source: Imagine the seller offers olive, dark green and khaki. You want a replacement jacket that will be worn with trousers purchased months ago. There are three different decisions here. First, establish what option you ordered. Second, establish which option the warehouse received. Third, decide how closely its appearance is likely to match the trousers in ordinary use. A single photograph can contribute evidence to all three, but seldom settles them all.
corrections.translation: 假设卖家提供橄榄绿、深绿和卡其三色，你想用新夹克搭配几个月前买的裤子。先弄清订单选了哪个色号，再确认仓库收到的选项，最后判断日常光线下能否与裤子搭配。一张照片可以为三步提供线索，却很少能一次解决全部疑问。

corrections.source: For the first decision, save the seller's original option text and selected swatch at checkout. When comparing translations, check any model code beside the colour. A translation might display khaki for two options that differ in green or brown undertone. If the order confirmation contains only a model code, keep the seller option mapping that connects that code to the swatch. If you did not save it and the page later changes, ask for clarification instead of reconstructing the mapping from a similar listing.
corrections.translation: 要确认下单选中了哪种颜色，保存结算时的卖家原文、色块及旁边的款式代码。两种分别偏绿、偏棕的颜色都可能被翻译成“卡其”。若订单确认只显示代码，留好代码和色块的对应关系。页面后来变动而你未保存时，应询问卖家，不要借另一条相似链接自建对应表。

corrections.source: For the second decision, inspect the current unit's label, packaging sticker or identifiable option details. A seller label matching the confirmed option gives stronger evidence about nominal colour than a guess based purely on screen appearance. It still cannot prove that two batches look identical. A photograph of the unit and its identifying information in the same frame helps ensure that the label belongs to the pictured jacket rather than another green item in the order.
corrections.translation: 要确认仓库收到的是哪个色号，查看实物标签、包装贴纸或其他能标识该选项的细节。标签与订单一致，比只凭屏幕判断更能证明标称颜色，但仍不能证明两批实物看起来完全相同。请把夹克和识别标签拍在同一张图中，避免错用订单里另一件绿色物品的标签。

corrections.source: For the third decision, describe how close a match you actually require. Complementary tones may be perfectly acceptable for separate garments worn casually. A replacement panel for an existing outfit could need a much closer match. An online photograph cannot establish an exact match under every light. Identifying the decision threshold keeps you from asking for several extra images that still cannot resolve a requirement for a physically exact shade.
corrections.translation: 最后明确自己要求的色差范围。日常搭配的两件衣服，色调协调就可能足够；替换现有服装的一块拼片，则可能要求非常接近。网络照片不能证明所有光线下都同色。先定义什么程度可以接受，才不会反复索要无法解决实物精确配色问题的照片。

corrections.source: A neutral wall behind the jacket can help reveal a strong colour cast when the wall itself appears yellow or blue. It is not a calibrated reference unless you know its real colour and lighting. A cream floor can be genuinely cream; correcting every picture until it looks white can introduce a new error. Look for consistent changes affecting several objects in the frame before attributing a difference solely to the garment.
corrections.translation: 夹克后方原本为中性色的墙若明显偏黄或偏蓝，可以提示画面有色偏。但不知道墙面实色和光源时，它不能当作经过校准的色卡。奶油色地板可能本来就是浅米色，硬把每张图调到地板发白反而会制造误差。先看画面中多个物体是否一起偏色，再判断是否仅衣服颜色不同。

corrections.source: Cameras and screens add another layer of variation. A phone can adjust exposure when a dark jacket fills most of the frame, making dark green look lighter than it appeared in a wider shot. Your display brightness and colour mode can affect what you see. Looking at the same image on a second device can expose a large display difference, but two screens agreeing is still not a physical comparison with your trousers.
corrections.translation: 手机和屏幕也会影响颜色。深色夹克占满画面时，手机可能自动提高曝光，让墨绿色相比全景照片显得更浅。屏幕亮度和显示模式也会改变观感。用第二台设备打开同图能发现明显的屏幕差异，但两块屏幕看起来一致，也不等于已与自己的裤子做过实物比色。

corrections.source: If option identity is uncertain, request the jacket laid out beside its colour label. If the concern is a patch or uneven panel, request a wider view and one close view under consistent neutral lighting, identifying the exact area. If the concern is the difference between olive and dark green, ask whether the two available variants can be compared under the same light. These are different requests because they test different explanations.
corrections.translation: 不确定款式色号时，请把夹克与色标一起平铺拍摄。怀疑某处有斑或拼片颜色不均时，标明位置，请在一致的中性光下拍全景和特写。如果纠结橄榄绿与深绿，则问能否把两个实际可用的款式放在同一光源下对照。不同疑点需要不同照片。

corrections.source: End the decision with a record of what is confirmed and what remains subjective. For the green jacket, that might be the correct seller code visible, no persistent patch across the main panel, and an exact match to your existing trousers still unknown. Keep this note with the order. If you later choose another item from the same gallery, you can reuse the comparison method while treating its colour, seller and batch as a new question.
corrections.translation: 结束时写清已核实事实和主观部分。例如绿色夹克上可见所选卖家代码，前身在不同照片里没有固定色斑，但是否与现有裤子完全同色仍未知。把结论随订单保存。下次看同一图库的其他商品，可以复用方法；颜色、卖家和批次仍要重新核对。

corrections.source: For the second view, ask for a measurement across the usable opening between the points that actually limit insertion. Explain that the exterior pocket seam may be wider than the zip opening. For the third, specify a depth measurement from the inside base to the usable top if this is possible without damaging the bag. Neither measurement by itself establishes whether a rigid object with a thick case fits; the thickness, lining, corners and shape also matter. Make that limitation explicit in the decision.
corrections.translation: 第二张图应量实际限制物品放入的两个端点之间的净开口。口袋外侧缝线的总宽度可能比拉链打开后可用的宽度大。第三张图可在不损伤包的前提下，量内袋底部到可用上缘的深度。能否放入带厚壳的硬物还与厚度、里布、圆角和外形有关，不能只凭其中一个尺寸判断。

corrections.source: Use a simple order of details: identify the unit, name the feature, describe the position, specify the endpoints and say what must remain visible. A request such as measure the bag can produce its outside height. A more precise request would name the rear pocket of the black medium backpack, ask for its zip opened, and request a tape across the unobstructed opening with zero and the final reading visible. The extra words only describe choices that could otherwise lead to the wrong measurement.
corrections.translation: 依次说明是哪件商品、看哪个部位、如何摆放、从哪里量到哪里，以及哪些内容要留在画面里。只说“量一下包”，对方可能量外部高度。可以改为“请打开黑色 M 码背包的后袋拉链，用卷尺横量不受阻挡的净开口，让零刻度和末端读数都入镜”。

corrections.source: Mention the unit you need, but keep any conversion in your own record. If the warehouse returns centimetres and your comparison item is measured in inches, convert consistently before deciding. Avoid comparing a tablet's advertised screen diagonal with an opening width. Measure the actual object in its case across the dimension that must pass through the opening. Check its depth and corner shape as well.
corrections.translation: 说明所需单位，换算则自行留档。仓库给的是厘米，而对照物量的是英寸时，应统一单位后判断。别把平板标称屏幕对角线直接与袋口宽度比较。给平板装上保护壳，实测穿过袋口时所需的宽度，并留意厚度和圆角形状。

corrections.source: On receipt, ask whether the photo identifies the unit, exposes the feature and makes the requested observation readable. If two of the three are satisfied, identify the single remaining gap. A clear measurement against an unidentified black bag leaves unit identity uncertain. A well-identified bag with the zero mark hidden leaves the measurement uncertain. These are concise follow-up questions that a person at the warehouse can act on.
corrections.translation: 补图到手后核对三项：是否能认出是哪一件、目标部位是否入镜、需要的文字或读数能否看清。若只差一项，就只追问那一项。不知是哪只黑包，即使读数清晰也无法对应；包已确认，但零刻度被挡住，则测量还未核实。

corrections.source: If the evidence contradicts the original offer, quote the exact part of the paid option or seller description that conflicts. If it merely falls short of your own preferred dimension, describe the fit issue and consult the current purchase terms. Those situations can have different available remedies, and an accurate message makes it easier for support to respond appropriately.
corrections.translation: 如果实物证据与卖家下单时写明的商品说明不符，请逐字摘录已付款选项或描述中冲突的那一句。如果只是没达到个人偏好的尺寸，应说明哪里不适合，并查本单适用的购买条款。两种情况可用的处理方式可能不同，写准确更便于客服判断。

corrections.source: When the additional picture arrives, reply in the same thread with the decision it supports. An example is that the new close-up shows both zipper pulls and resolves your question about the pockets, while the lining remains outside the photograph. This closes the current request without accidentally treating the lining as checked. If you need a different question answered, describe it separately and verify whether the warehouse can still access the item. Several unlabeled replies on a single image can leave the person reading your case unsure which issue is open. Saving the answer with the corresponding photograph keeps the evidence useful after the parcel leaves the warehouse.
corrections.translation: 补图到达后，在原对话中记录它解决了哪个问题。例如新特写清楚显示两个拉链头，已能确认口袋，而里布仍不在画面里。这样能结掉当前要求，又不会误记为里布也查过。要确认其他特征时应另行说明，并确认仓库还拿得到商品。每个回答和对应照片配在一起，出库后也能追溯。

corrections.source: Copy each paid line with its unit, selected option, quantity and any explicitly included components. A bag might include a shoulder strap, a set might include matching shorts and a jacket might have a removable hood. Record only what the selected offer actually describes.
corrections.translation: 把实付订单逐行列出，写明销售单位、选项、数量以及明确包含的配件。包可能含肩带，套装可能含配套短裤，夹克可能配可拆帽。核对时只计算所选商品说明确实列出的内容。

corrections.source: If the listing shows a range of choices, return to the paid order. A promotional image of a complete outfit does not establish that the option sold every piece. Save screenshots if the seller later edits the listing, but keep the payment confirmation as your anchor for what you requested.
corrections.translation: 商品页有多个可选组合时，要回到实付订单。模特穿着整套衣服的宣传图不能证明你买的选项包含所有单品。卖家后来修改商品页时可保存截图，但核对当初所选内容仍以支付时的订单确认为依据。

corrections.source: Sort photographs by warehouse entry and start with a full overview. Identify pieces that are present, pieces obscured by wrapping and pieces not seen. A missing image is different from a missing part. If a small accessory could be inside a pocket or protective pouch, ask for a check before declaring a shortage.
corrections.translation: 按入库编号整理图片，先看整组货物的全景。把明确看到、被包装挡住和暂未看到的部件分开。缺少照片并不等于缺少配件。小配件若可能放在口袋或保护袋里，先请仓库检查，再报告短缺。

corrections.source: A seller may send one line in several boxes or several lines in one. Compare domestic tracking and warehouse entries before arranging international shipment. The first intake photograph can be complete for its carton while another carton remains in transit.
corrections.translation: 卖家可能把一条商品明细分几箱寄，也可能把多条明细合成一箱。安排国际发货前，先对照国内运单号和入库记录。第一箱的入库照片可以完整展示该箱内容，而第二箱此时仍在途中。

corrections.source: Consider a hypothetical order for a backpack with a detachable strap, two shirts in different sizes and a pack of three headbands. The seller of the bag ships separately. A second seller sends the shirts and headbands together. You have several purchase lines but only two outer shipments. If you make a checklist of outer boxes alone, both boxes can arrive while a shirt is still the wrong size or the small accessory pack remains unverified.
corrections.translation: 假设订单包括带可拆肩带的背包、两件不同尺码的衬衫，以及一包三条发带。背包卖家单独发货，另一家把衬衫和发带一起寄出。这是多条商品明细、两个外箱。如果只清点两箱是否到货，便可能漏掉一件衬衫尺码不对，或那包小发带还没确认。

corrections.source: Give the bag a line for the main piece and one for the strap. Write down where the seller option says the strap is included. Give each shirt its own line with its size and colour. Give the headbands a line with the pack count and expected number of pieces. This preparation is easier before the warehouse images arrive, because it directs your attention toward the things most likely to be hidden or confused. It also prevents a new assumption, such as expecting an extra belt visible only on the model, from creeping into the inspection.
corrections.translation: 背包本体和肩带各列一行，并标出哪段卖家选项说明写明肩带包含在内。两件衬衫分别标注颜色和尺码。发带一行同时写包装数和里面应有几条。在看入库图之前列好清单，可以优先找容易藏住或混淆的部件，也能避免把只系在模特身上的腰带误列为赠品。

corrections.source: Open the bag's current warehouse entry. Suppose the overview shows the bag and protective wrapping while the internal pockets remain closed. You can confirm the main bag is visible. You cannot yet say whether the strap is missing. Ask whether it is stored inside the bag and request a view of the strap and its attachment hardware if that matters. If a photograph shows the strap but hides one clip, decide whether the clip affects your decision before requesting another view.
corrections.translation: 打开本次背包入库记录。若全景只见包和外部防护，内袋都还关着，只能确认背包本体已经入库，肩带仍待核实。问肩带是否收在包里；如扣具影响使用，再请仓库拍出肩带和连接件。若图中已有整条肩带却挡住一个扣，也可先决定是否确有必要补拍。

corrections.source: Do not ask for the entire mixed shipment to be unpacked again without identifying the missing observation. A message that mentions the two shirt sizes and the sealed headband pack allows the inspector to target the relevant pieces. The broader question are all my products correct could receive an answer based on carton count when your concern is a size label.
corrections.translation: 不要笼统地请仓库把整批混装商品重新拆一遍。指出要核对的两件衬衫尺码，以及那包未开封发带，检查人员就能定位相应物品。只问“所有商品都没问题吗”，对方可能按箱数回答，无法解决你对尺码标签的疑问。

corrections.source: If the second shirt is the wrong size and the other pieces are correct, keep the affected line open while marking the unaffected pieces confirmed. Ask what the current options are for the one shirt before submitting the whole parcel. Retain its tags and packaging if a return or exchange may be considered. Avoid assuming the entire carton must be returned or that part of a set can always be separated; ask for the conditions tied to the actual seller purchase.
corrections.translation: 若第二件衬衫尺码错误，其他物品无误，只把这件衬衫标成待处理，其余分别标记已核实。整箱提交国际发货前，询问这件衬衫可怎样处理；若考虑退换，保留吊牌和包装。不要自行假定必须整箱退回，或套装一定可以拆退，应按这笔购买的卖家条件核实。

corrections.source: A down jacket and a box of books can have very different relationships between weight and space. The route's actual billing rules determine which difference affects cost. Use two fully described parcels instead of comparing product weights alone.
corrections.translation: 一件羽绒服和一箱书占用的空间与重量关系可能截然不同。究竟哪项影响运费，要看具体线路的计费规则。对比时写清两箱各自的完整包装尺寸和实重，而不要只对照商品净重。

corrections.source: Suppose a light parcel weighs 1.5 kilograms and measures 45 by 35 by 25 centimetres. Its volume is 39,375 cubic centimetres. A dense 4-kilogram parcel measuring 25 by 20 by 15 centimetres occupies 7,500 cubic centimetres. The light parcel uses more than five times as much space despite weighing less than half as much.
corrections.translation: 假设轻包裹重 1.5 千克，外尺寸为 45 × 35 × 25 厘米，体积为 39,375 立方厘米。另一件较紧凑的包裹重 4 千克，尺寸为 25 × 20 × 15 厘米，体积为 7,500 立方厘米。轻包裹的重量还不到重包裹的一半，占用的空间却是其五倍以上。

corrections.source: If a hypothetical service divides cubic centimetres by 6,000 and compares that result in kilograms with scale weight, the light parcel has a dimensional figure of about 6.56 kilograms. The dense parcel has a dimensional figure of 1.25 kilograms. Under that example's higher-of-two rule, the light parcel would have the larger billing base.
corrections.translation: 假设某服务把以立方厘米计的体积除以 6,000，将所得千克数与实重比较。轻包裹的体积重约为 6.56 千克，紧凑的重包裹为 1.25 千克。按照这个假设中取体积重和实重较高者的规则，轻包裹的计费基数反而更大。

corrections.source: These numbers illustrate a method, not a VigorBuy tariff. A service may set a different divisor, threshold, minimum or rounding increment. Read the route description returned for your own contents and destination. Identify both the governing figure and how it becomes the final billed weight.
corrections.translation: 这些数字演示计算方法。VigorBuy 不同线路采用的体积重除数、门槛、最低计费重量和进位单位可能不同。应阅读针对本次物品和目的地实际显示的线路说明，先看按实重还是体积重，再确认它怎样换算、进位成最终计费重量。

corrections.source: Reducing the large parcel's height to 20 centimetres while keeping the other sides fixed gives a volume of 31,500 cubic centimetres. With the same hypothetical divisor its dimensional figure falls to 5.25 kilograms. That may alter a quote governed by volume but tells you nothing by itself about the charge on an actual-weight-only route.
corrections.translation: 保持长、宽不变，将大包裹的高度减至 20 厘米，体积就变成 31,500 立方厘米。按同一个假设除数计算，体积重降至 5.25 千克。如果这条线路以体积重计费，报价可能会变化；对于只按实重计费的线路，单凭这项变化无法判断收费。

corrections.source: Enter the same destination and accurately described contents for each scenario. A service that excludes an item or cannot accept its dimensions is not an available price. Keep optional services and currency consistent across the quotes.
corrections.translation: 每个方案都输入同一目的地，准确描述里面装的商品。若某线路不接受该品类或包装尺寸，就不能把它的价格列作可选报价。比较时统一币种以及勾选的增值服务。

corrections.source: Record the result beside its assumptions. A cheaper quote for the compact parcel cannot prove that one route is cheaper for all your future purchases. The useful finding is narrower: for these packed measurements, on the displayed routes and date, one combination produced a particular total.
corrections.translation: 把报价和计算前提放在一起。一只小而重的包裹得到较低报价，并不能推出今后所有商品走这条路线都省钱。能确认的是：在记录当天、所列路线和实测装箱尺寸下，这一种组合得到这个总价。

corrections.source: Take the light hypothetical parcel from the earlier example and imagine it contains a soft jacket and a rigid gift box. The buyer needs the presentation box to arrive intact. Compressing only the jacket may save space, but crushing the gift box would defeat the purpose of the purchase. Begin with permissible packing options rather than calculating the lowest theoretical volume and asking the warehouse to force the goods into it.
corrections.translation: 沿用前面的轻箱例子，假设里面装着柔软的夹克和必须完好送达的硬质礼盒。只压缩夹克可能省空间；若把礼盒挤坏，就违背了送礼目的。先列出允许采用的包装方法，再计算，不要先算理论最小体积再要求仓库硬塞。

corrections.source: Assume Plan B changes the outer dimensions from 45 by 35 by 25 to 42 by 34 by 22 centimetres. The new volume is 31,416 cubic centimetres, compared with 39,375 before. At the illustrative 6,000 divisor, those volumes produce dimensional figures of about 5.24 and 6.56 kilograms respectively. Compare them with the measured scale weights under the actual route rule. These calculations establish a possible difference in billed weight; they do not establish a particular monetary saving.
corrections.translation: 假设方案 B 把包裹外尺寸从 45 × 35 × 25 厘米调整为 42 × 34 × 22 厘米，体积就从 39,375 立方厘米降至 31,416 立方厘米。使用示例除数 6,000，新旧方案的体积重分别约为 5.24 千克和 6.56 千克。按实际线路规则，再分别与称出的实重比较。这项计算能说明计费重量可能不同，具体能省多少钱仍需看报价。

corrections.source: Now apply an illustrative upward half-kilogram billing increment. A governing figure of 6.56 becomes 7.0 kilograms, while 5.24 becomes 5.5. The change in billing bands is larger than a comparison of just the first decimal place might suggest. If a route instead has a minimum of 7 kilograms for this service, the lower figure could still be priced at the same minimum. That is why the entire route rule, including any minimum and how billing increments are calculated, must be checked.
corrections.translation: 假设计费重量按半千克为单位向上进位，6.56 千克就按 7.0 千克计，5.24 千克按 5.5 千克计。比较进位后的档位，结果可能跟只看小数点后一位时的印象不同。如果这项服务最低按 7 千克收费，两种情况仍可能收取相同的最低费用。因此要核实线路的起收费门槛和进位规则。

corrections.source: For the 4-kilogram parcel of books, the earlier 7,500-cubic-centimetre carton has a 1.25-kilogram dimensional result under the example divisor. Removing a thin layer of outer packing would make that volume slightly smaller, but scale weight would still govern under a higher-of-two rule. If weight remained above the same actual-weight billing threshold, the cheaper-looking volume could have no effect on the quoted freight.
corrections.translation: 前面那箱书实重 4 千克，纸箱体积 7,500 立方厘米，按示例除数换算的体积重为 1.25 千克。去掉一层薄薄的外包装只能略微缩小体积。在实重和体积重取大值的规则下，仍要看实重；如果实重没有降到更低计费档位，体积虽小了，运费报价也可能不变。

corrections.source: Write down the single governing condition for each scenario if the route provides it. For the light bulky parcel it may be dimensional weight. For the compact books it may be actual weight. For an oversized combined carton it may be a maximum side length that removes the route entirely. Different governing conditions explain why the same packing change can have different results on different parcels.
corrections.translation: 若线路有明确规则，把每个装箱方案中起决定作用的条件写下来。轻而蓬松的箱子可能按体积重，大箱里的书可能按实重。合并后若最长边超限，则线路可能根本不可选。同一种包装调整之所以产生不同结果，正是因为各箱受不同条件限制。

corrections.source: When a final quote seems surprising, compare its inputs with the estimate before assuming a mistake. Check whether a dimension changed, the scale was measured after reinforcement, the route applies a different billing unit or an optional service was added. Ask about the specific line that remains unexplained. For example, ask which exterior dimension and divisor led to the displayed billed weight instead of asking why a small jacket is expensive.
corrections.translation: 最终报价出乎意料时，先比较输入值：外尺寸有没有变、是不是加固后才称重、线路是否按不同重量档进位、有无新加服务。然后只问仍解释不了的那一行。比如问“哪些外尺寸和体积重除数算出了这个计费重量”，比只问“小夹克为什么这么贵”更容易查证。

corrections.source: Keep the calculation, actual packed measurements and selected route with the parcel reference. Reuse the method for a future parcel, but update every current dimension and tariff condition. The lasting lesson concerns the relationship between scale weight, exterior volume and route rules; none of the illustrative values here promises a VigorBuy rate for any particular destination.
corrections.translation: 把计算过程、实际外箱尺寸、实重和所选线路随包裹号保存。下次能复用的是方法；三边和费率条件仍应重新核实。这些示例说明实重、外部体积与线路规则怎样共同影响计费，不构成 VigorBuy 对某一目的地的运价承诺。

corrections.source: To compare cartons after repacking, record all three external dimensions again. A narrower side can come with a longer side if the item was rotated, and measuring just the original problem dimension can hide that change. Put the new length, width, height and scale reading on one line with the packing revision. Bring that complete line to the route estimator, then keep the previous result beside it so you can explain any difference.
corrections.translation: 重新装箱后，外部长、宽、高都要重测。把商品转个方向，原来超限的边可能缩短，另一边却可能变长。将新尺寸、实测重量和本次包装调整写在同一行，整行输入运费估算器，并保留旧结果以说明差额。

corrections.source: Save the route name exactly as displayed and the date the result appeared. Record the quoted total, currency, billing weight if shown and optional services selected. Keep any displayed limits or conditions relevant to your shipment with the estimate.
corrections.translation: 照抄显示的线路名称，记下报价日期、总价、币种、计费重量（若有）和勾选的可选服务。与本件货物有关的尺寸限制等条件也要和报价一起保存。

corrections.source: Imagine an early estimate used a 2.0-kilogram parcel and the warehouse later reports 2.4 kilograms. If the route uses upward half-kilogram increments and actual weight governs, the second observation would enter a different band. If volumetric weight already governed both quotes, the scale change might make no difference. You need the route rule to interpret the numbers.
corrections.translation: 假设最初按 2.0 千克估算，仓库后来实际称得 2.4 千克。若这条线路采用实重且按半千克向上进位，第二个数值会进入更高档位。若两次报价都由体积重决定，这点实重变化可能不影响运费。要结合该线路的规则解读。

corrections.source: If the quote changes currency between the two screenshots, return to an underlying currency comparison where possible. The amount converted into your home currency can move even when the underlying freight cost stays constant. Keep any payment conversion charge separate from a freight change.
corrections.translation: 两张报价截图若显示不同币种，尽量先换回同一种基础货币对比。基础运费不变，换成自己的付款币种后，数字也会随汇率变化。付款时的换汇手续费和运费本身的变化要分开记。

corrections.source: Make a short comparison of old and new values for contents, packing choice, dimensions, scale weight, route, currency and services. Circle the first difference that can explain the change. If several inputs changed together, obtain fresh like-for-like quotes before assigning the difference to one cause.
corrections.translation: 并排列出新旧记录的物品、包装方式、外尺寸、实重、路线、币种和所选服务，标出最先能解释价差的变化。如果有几个条件同时变动，应先取得条件一致的新报价，再判断到底哪一项造成差额。

corrections.source: Imagine a buyer saves a screenshot showing 35 in their chosen currency for a clothing parcel. Weeks later the payment screen shows 46. That eleven-unit difference could arise from weight, packing, route, services or conversion. Without the original inputs it cannot be explained. Recreate the event with four dated entries instead: the shopping estimate before purchase, the warehouse item estimate, the packed parcel quote and the amount actually paid.
corrections.translation: 假设买家保存了一张截图，衣物包裹在所选币种下显示为 35。几周后的付款页面显示 46。相差的 11 个货币单位可能来自重量、包装、线路、服务项目或换汇；缺少原始输入条件就无法断定原因。可以按日期分别记下购买前预估、商品入库后预估、打包后运费报价和实付款，逐次对照。

corrections.source: For the shopping entry, list the items you plan to purchase and any assumed weights or sizes. Label them estimates. At the warehouse stage, replace assumptions with measured information where available but keep the first entry intact. Some warehouse weights may include seller packaging while the final parcel can include additional outer protection. Record what was measured rather than treating each new number as proof that the earlier estimate was dishonest.
corrections.translation: 采购阶段先列出想买的商品，假设重量和尺寸都标成估算值。到仓后另开一条记录，用已有的实测值替代假设，保留原始记录。入库重量可能含卖家包装，而最终包裹还会加外部防护。写清每次测的对象，才能解释数值为何改变。

corrections.source: Suppose the buyer wants to know whether keeping the retail shoe box changes the available route. Create two scenarios with the same shoes, destination, date and services. Change only the packing choice and its associated measured or estimated exterior dimensions and actual weight. Capture eligible routes for both. If the final parcel is still unmeasured, label this an exploratory result rather than a quote guaranteed to survive packing.
corrections.translation: 若要看保留原鞋盒会不会改变可选线路，用同一双鞋、目的地、日期和服务做两套方案。只改是否保留鞋盒，并调整由此产生的外尺寸和实重。分别保存可用线路。最终包裹若尚未实测，应标明只是试算，而非装箱后仍然有效的承诺报价。

corrections.source: If route A appears for the smaller carton but disappears for the larger one, inspect any displayed size or weight criteria. A small change in the longest side can affect eligibility. Avoid comparing route A in one scenario with an unrelated route B in the other and calling the whole price difference the cost of the box. Report it more precisely: preserving the box produced this parcel description and changed which quoted services were available at the time of comparison.
corrections.translation: 小箱显示路线 A、大箱不显示时，先查页面列出的尺寸或重量限制。最长边轻微变化就可能让路线不再可选。不要把小箱的 A 路线与大箱的 B 路线相减，把差额全算作“留鞋盒的费用”。准确的说法是，保留鞋盒改变了包裹资料，从而改变了比较当时可选的报价服务。

corrections.source: Sometimes the buyer already has only the screenshot of 35. Read any visible route name, date, currency or destination from it and list the unknowns. Retrieve a warehouse entry, purchase confirmation or note that independently establishes one of those details. Do not fill a missing weight with the current packed weight and claim to have reproduced the old quote. The old screenshot can still show that a figure was observed while leaving its basis uncertain.
corrections.translation: 如果手里只剩一张显示 35 的截图，先抄下还能看清的线路名、日期、币种或目的地，列出哪些信息仍缺失。用入库记录、购买确认或单独保存的笔记逐项核实。不能拿现在打包后的重量补填当初未知的重量，再声称复算出了旧报价。截图能证明当时看到过这个数，但未必说明它的计算依据。

corrections.source: Tracking events describe observations of a particular parcel at particular points. A status can look alarming when you have opened the seller's domestic tracking instead of the international parcel record. Identify the journey before interpreting the text.
corrections.translation: 物流轨迹只描述某个包裹在某个节点发生的事件。若打开的是卖家到中国仓库的国内运单，却按跨国包裹理解，状态就容易被误读。先核准运单属于哪一段，再解释状态文字。

corrections.source: Keep the purchase number, domestic tracking number, warehouse entry, outbound parcel number and international tracking reference separate. When several purchases share one international box, they can still have different domestic numbers. Copy the reference from the outbound confirmation when following the journey to your address.
corrections.translation: 将购买订单号、中国境内运单号、仓库入库编号、出库包裹号和国际运单号分别保存。多笔采购可以装进同一个国际包裹，但各自的国内运单仍可能不同。查询寄往自己地址的运输进度时，使用出库确认里的对应编号。

corrections.source: Read the destination shown beside any delivered status. A delivery at the warehouse closes the seller-to-warehouse leg. It does not mean the international delivery failed. If the number belongs to an outbound parcel and the destination matches, the same word requires a different investigation.
corrections.translation: 凡是显示“已签收”，先读旁边的收货地点。仓库签收意味着卖家到仓库这段国内运输已完成，并不表示国际段配送失败。若编号属于国际出库包裹，且目的地无误，同样的状态就要按国际配送另行查证。

corrections.source: Distinguish a shipping label being created from the carrier confirming physical receipt. A handoff from one carrier to another may produce a gap between visible scans. Note the last dated observation and its location instead of interpreting every quiet interval as a separate problem.
corrections.translation: 区分已生成面单和承运商已实际揽收。转交给下一家承运商时，公开查询可能暂时没有新扫描。记录最后一次已确认事件的时间、地点，再判断后续，不要把每段静默期都另算一次异常。

corrections.source: If a parcel shows out for delivery, verify which carrier and locality reported it. Check the instructions presented by that carrier. A generic delivery estimate is less specific than a failure notice asking for a particular action. Use the official carrier or order account to review that action.
corrections.translation: 轨迹显示“正在派送”时，要核对是哪家承运商、哪个地区发出的状态，并阅读该承运商给出的说明。一般预计时间没有写明具体操作的投递失败通知那么明确。如需操作，通过承运商官方渠道或订单账户核实。

corrections.source: Record the outbound parcel reference, carrier number, last confirmed scan, destination country and the particular discrepancy. If the parcel is marked delivered at the right destination but you have not received it, preserve that scan and any delivery proof provided. Contact the relevant carrier or agent through its normal support channel.
corrections.translation: 记下出库包裹号、承运商单号、最后一次已确认扫描、目的国家和具体疑点。若目的地无误却显示签收而你没收到，保存该次轨迹和已有签收凭证，再走对应承运商或代购平台的常规客服渠道查询。

corrections.source: Consider an illustrative order for shoes and a jacket from two sellers. The shoes reach the warehouse on the third day after seller dispatch, while the jacket arrives later. These dates describe a hypothetical sequence, not a VigorBuy delivery promise. Until you select the stored entries and an outbound parcel is created, the two seller tracking numbers belong to independent domestic journeys. A delivered event against the shoes can therefore be entirely correct even though the buyer has not received anything at home.
corrections.translation: 假设向两家卖家分别购买鞋和夹克。鞋在卖家发货后第三天入库，夹克稍后才到。这只是演示顺序，不代表 VigorBuy 的时效承诺。你选定入库商品并生成国际包裹之前，两个卖家运单只对应两段各自独立的国内配送。鞋子显示签收完全可能是仓库已收货，你家并未收到。

corrections.source: Now suppose you submit one international parcel containing both pieces. Record the outbound parcel reference and carrier tracking number against the two purchase lines. The first carrier event might concern electronic shipment information. Read whether it actually says that a physical parcel was received. A label can be created before collection. In your notes, write label recorded or parcel accepted according to what the carrier displayed instead of treating the two as interchangeable milestones.
corrections.translation: 接下来将两件商品合成一件国际包裹，在两条采购记录旁标出出库包裹号和承运商运单号。首条轨迹有时仅表示电子面单信息已经收到。面单可以在取件前生成，所以应按原文分别写“已创建面单”或“承运商已收件”。

corrections.source: When the destination carrier records an event, compare the parcel reference, destination and what the upstream carrier said about the handoff. It is possible for two systems to use different wording for related events. Preserve the original text and date when contacting support. Rewriting arrived at destination facility as delivered to recipient changes the meaning and can send an investigation down the wrong path.
corrections.translation: 目的地承运商出现新轨迹时，核对包裹号、目的地以及上游承运商记下的交接情况。不同系统可能用不同措辞描述相关事件。联系支持时保留原文和日期。“抵达目的地处理中心”不等于“收件人已签收”，改写后会误导调查。

corrections.source: If the number really does belong to the international delivery and shows delivered, verify the listed destination and delivery partner. Check any available proof, recipient instructions or collection location through the normal carrier or agent account. Some statuses concern delivery to a pickup location or partner rather than presentation at a home address. Read the full event before reporting that a package was delivered to an unknown person.
corrections.translation: 确认编号确实对应国际件且状态为签收后，再看目的地和末端承运商。通过承运商或代购账户查询签收凭证、收件指示或自提点。有些“送达”指送到合作网点或取件处。读完完整事件，再判断是否真的交给了不认识的人。

corrections.source: If the carrier requests action, inspect the message through the carrier's published service or normal order account. Identify what is being requested, by whom and for which reference. An unsolicited message containing a familiar brand name is not enough to link it to your parcel. Check its demand against the actual tracking information before responding. Retain the confirmed notice and any response you submit so the subsequent event can be interpreted in context.
corrections.translation: 承运商要求采取行动时，到其公开的官方服务入口或原订单账户查看。核对提出要求的是谁、需要做什么、对应哪个包裹。陌生信息里出现熟悉的品牌名不足以证明它属于你的件。先对照真实物流记录，再保存经核实的通知和自己的回复。

corrections.source: If two people at the destination may contact support, agree who will own the enquiry. Duplicate reports can produce separate reference numbers and conflicting updates about the same parcel. Give the other person the destination carrier name, the locally recognised tracking number and the last confirmed scan, plus the time you last checked. If a new status appears under one number, keep the original record as well. Later it may help the shipper identify the partner that accepted the parcel before its local number began showing events.
corrections.translation: 如果目的地有两个人可能联系售后，先约定由谁统一跟进。同一包裹重复报查可能产生不同的案件编号和互相冲突的进度。把末端承运商名称、当地可查的运单号、最后一次已确认扫描及查询时间告知另一人。若新状态只出现在新编号下，也要保留旧记录，以便寄件方追查当地运单更新前是哪家合作方接件。
